lessons.keep: Pair a physical action with a readable output beside the person.
lessons.avoid: Treating a floating post mockup as proof that content was published.
lessons.open: Publication flow, price precision and actual audio delivery remain unverified.
try: For Tin, let a user say a deliberately rough campaign idea, then show the resulting draft and approval control.
Compare a shorter two-example comedy pitch with the longer monologue while keeping the same price ending.
